scientific_integrity: Classical rank-one transform coefficient is credited; no claim of independent validation or exhaustive novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Square Fourier sampling only on the nonzero rank-one matrix locus; not arbitrary rank strata, phases, or every minor. Finite numerical checks corroborate but do not prove the universal theorem. Historical priority remains bounded by accessible literature; the original full Delsarte paper was not read.
title: Exact singular spectrum of self-Fourier sampling on finite-field rank-one matrix cones
